title: First steps
description: Open a drawing, find your way around, draw a line and save.

steps.title: Open a drawing
steps.text: Open the File menu, choose Open… and pick a DWG or DXF file.

steps.title: Zoom to fit
steps.text: Click Zoom to fit to see the whole drawing. You can also turn the mouse wheel to zoom, or drag with the middle button to pan.

steps.title: The command line
steps.text: Click here, type L and press Enter. Every tool has a short command like this.

steps.title: Draw a line
steps.text: Choose the Line tool (or use the command you just typed). Click two points in the drawing, then press Enter to finish.

steps.title: Object snap
steps.text: SNAP makes the cursor jump to ends, midpoints and centres. Click it, or press F3, to switch it on or off.

steps.title: Save your work
steps.text: Open the File menu and choose Save, or press Ctrl+S.

steps.title: Help
steps.text: Open the Help menu to read what the program can and cannot do, check the converter log, or see the About box.
